prompt: Retail: Generate dates 2024-01-01 through 2024-01-07 using a recursive CTE. Left join `[retail].[Orders]` to show daily order counts including zero days.

;WITH Days AS (SELECT CONVERT(date,'20240101',112) AS D UNION ALL SELECT DATEADD(day,1,D) FROM Days WHERE D < '20240107')
SELECT d.D, COUNT(f.OrderID) AS RecordCount FROM Days d LEFT JOIN [retail].[Orders] f ON f.OrderDate = d.D GROUP BY d.D ORDER BY d.D OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100);
